# Link Graph Tests — links show, backlinks, orphans commands

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write links-test-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/links-test-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write another-links-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/another-links-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write links-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/links-decision.md'

stdin ../broken-input.md
exec akb write broken-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/broken-note.md'

# --- links show displays outbound links ---

exec akb links notes/links-test-note.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'another-note'
stdout 'search-decision'

# --- links show displays broken links ---

exec akb links notes/broken-note.md
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'nonexistent-page'

# --- links show with nonexistent page returns error ---

! exec akb links notes/no-such-page.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- backlinks shows inbound links ---

exec akb backlinks notes/links-test-note.md
stdout 'notes/another-links-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/links-decision.md'

# --- backlinks with nonexistent page returns error ---

! exec akb backlinks notes/no-such-page.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- orphans shows pages with zero inbound links ---

exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/broken-note.md'

# --- orphans on empty KB returns no output ---

exec akb delete notes/links-test-note.md
exec akb delete notes/another-links-note.md
exec akb delete decisions/links-decision.md
exec akb delete notes/broken-note.md

exec akb orphans
! stdout .

# --- Missing search.db produces rebuild hint for links ---

exec rm .agent-kb/search.db

! exec akb links notes/links-test-note.md
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

! exec akb backlinks notes/links-test-note.md
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

! exec akb orphans
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

# --- Wikilink format variants ---

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

stdin ../wikilink-input.md
exec akb write wikilink-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/wikilink-note.md'

# links show resolves various wikilink formats
exec akb links notes/wikilink-note.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'another-links-note'

# --- Explicit destination links: [[bracket title]](dest.md) resolve to the dest ---

stdin ../explicit-dest-target-input.md
exec akb write explicit-dest-target.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/explicit-dest-target.md'

stdin ../explicit-dest-source-input.md
exec akb write explicit-dest-source.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/explicit-dest-source.md'

# links show records the destination as the raw target and resolves it to the
# destination page; the bracket title is display text, never a link target.
exec akb links notes/explicit-dest-source.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'notes/explicit-dest-target -> kb/notes/explicit-dest-target.md'
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'notes/missing-dest'
! stdout 'Bracket Title'

# backlinks are recorded against the destination page.
exec akb backlinks notes/explicit-dest-target.md
stdout 'notes/explicit-dest-source.md'

# the destination page has an inbound link, so it is not an orphan.
exec akb orphans
! stdout 'notes/explicit-dest-target.md'

# the lint sweep re-resolves the link graph; the broken explicit destination is
# reported as the destination, not the bracket title.
! exec akb lint
stdout 'broken link to \[\[notes/missing-dest\]\]'
! stdout 'Broken Bracket Title'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Links Test Note
summary: A note for link testing
tags: linktest
---
This note links to [[another-note]] and references [[decisions/search-decision]].

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Another Links Note
summary: Second note for link testing
tags: linktest
---
This note links back to [[links-test-note]].

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Links Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for link testing
tags: [linktest]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

We decided based on [[links-test-note]]. The decision records the reasoning behind the note-linking scheme, so the link graph resolves the note from here as a backlink.

## Decision

Decided. The decision keeps a single outbound link, which is enough to prove that backlinks are recorded for both page types.

## Consequences

Recorded. Deleting the decision removes the backlink from the note.

-- broken-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Broken Link Note
summary: Note with broken links
tags: linktest
---
This note has a [[nonexistent-page]] link.

-- wikilink-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Wikilink Format Note
summary: Note testing wikilink formats
tags: linktest
---
Simple link: [[another-links-note]]
Display link: [[another-links-note|alt display]]
Heading link: [[another-links-note#Introduction]]
Heading with display: [[another-links-note#Introduction|see intro]]

-- explicit-dest-target-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Explicit Destination Target
summary: Target reached through an explicit destination link
tags: linktest
---
This note is the destination of a wikilink that spells its path explicitly.

-- explicit-dest-source-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Explicit Destination Source
summary: Note linking through explicit destinations
tags: linktest
---
Explicit destination link: [[Bracket Title]](notes/explicit-dest-target.md)
Broken explicit destination link: [[Broken Bracket Title]](notes/missing-dest.md)
